notes.title: Demo Update 0.4.0
notes.notes:
The PizzaBoy Demo has recently been updated to version 0.4.0.

This update includes better winscreen art, so completing the demo feels more rewarding.

The title screen and game-over screen have also been updated

Enjoy Playing PizzaBoy!

notes.title: Check out PizzaBoy's Socials
notes.notes:
We are delighted to see people taking interest in PizzaBoy.

If you want to engage with the game and keep up with PizzaBoy's disastrous deliveries, you can do so here on Steam, as well as on our other platforms.

You can check out our social links below:
